# Cortex AI — Cross-Exchange Arbitrage Framework

> Open-source, non-custodial execution engine for real-time crypto arbitrage across CEXs (Binance, Bybit, OKX, HTX).

## Core Capabilities
- Real-time spread scanner with sub-second order routing.
- Supports BTC, ETH, TON, SOL, and 16+ pairs out of the box.
- Optional LLM signal filtering (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI).
- Non-custodial local key management (.env configuration).

## Key Files
- `main.py`: Entry point for scanner and execution modes.
- `scanners/`: Exchange-specific order-book monitoring modules.
- `execution/`: Local order routing and risk-check handlers.
- `config/.env`: Environment parameters setup.

## Technical Requirements
- Python 3.11+
- Node.js 20+
- License: MIT
